name: Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity
title: CWE-345: Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity
ai_text: In AI software this weakness shows up in MCP servers and the clients that talk to them, where trust in the other side is assumed rather than checked. Both given CVEs sit in that layer. In rmcp before 2.0.0, a malicious MCP server can take the victim's access token because the client does not properly verify who it is really connected to. In CKAN MCP Server before 0.4.112, crafted queries can poison a shared cache, so other users later receive data that was never genuine. The usual route is a server or query the client accepts at face value. The result is stolen credentials or corrupted shared results, with impact spreading to anyone using the same cache or token.
description: The product does not sufficiently verify the origin or authenticity of data, in a way that causes it to accept invalid data.
